title: G11 TRADE first-valid-apply clock starts at the slice's first canonical TRADE event after the fault
owner_rule_verbatim: nếu gate không đạt xác định là lỗi external thì nới gate rồi release gọn nhé
owner_rule_reference: owner rule 2026-10-18 ~16:00Z, with "duyệt hết theo recommend của bạn, k hỏi lại" (the coordinator recommendation A5 is approved without a further question)

rule.clock: max(fault_cleared_ms, first canonical TRADE kafka_create_time_ms > outage_start_ms - pre_fault_guard_ms)
rule.pre_fault_guard_basis: the G11 TRADE live bound (scripts/p184_g11_writer_restart_probe.py LIVE_BOUND_MS TRADE 3000): an event committed less than 3 s before the writer stopped may not have been applied, so it starts the clock at fault_cleared exactly as the frozen rule
rule.event_time_basis: Kafka record CreateTime of md.canonical.v2 (set by DL before its transaction commit, the earliest time the writer could read the event); the venue source time is reported next to it
rule.evidence: a read_committed, assign-only read of md.canonical.v2 by the pinned reader covering, on every partition carrying the slice, outage_start - guard .. first_apply (every assigned partition done, no read error); the event the probe saw applied first must be one of the canonical post-fault TRADE events of the slice. Missing or incomplete evidence: the slice keeps the frozen clock (A5 not applied to it).
rule.negative: an earlier post-fault TRADE event that the writer did not apply within 30 s moves the clock back to that event, so the slice FAILs
rule.unchanged_detail: caught up <= 60 s from fault_cleared, no rewind (high-water), cursor never ahead (roster complete), unresolved slices / observation window, every non-TRADE slice, every other gate; the frozen probe verdict() runs on the amended report
